      "rationale": "Represents multipath descriptors as unified Descriptor objects to enable proper round-tripping and unexpanded inspection. Currently 'multipath descriptor strings treat the multipath specifiers as syntactic sugar' and discard elements during parsing, which prevents preserving original multipath strings in wallet and RPC interfaces and blocks follow-up descriptor wallet improvements like #36443."
